  • Head. The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
  • Legs. The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.
  • Torso. The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

This transformation lasts until the target is affected by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or a greater restoration spell. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a wish spell or similar magic.

  • Tentacles. The otyugh's number of tentacles determine how many attacks they can make with Multiattack and how many creatures they can grapple with Tentacle Slam.

actions.name: Eye Psionics
actions.descriptionHtml:
The overmind creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who the overmind can see within 120 feet of them. They can't use the same effect twice in a turn.

  • 1. Charm Beam.

    The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the overmind for 1 hour, or until the overmind harms the creature or one of their allies.

  • 2. Compulsion Beam.

    The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make a weapon attack against them. Creatures who can't be charmed are unaffected.

  • 3. Toxic Vapors.

    The overmind chooses a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

  • 4. Telekinetic Beam.

    The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of the move. Alternatively, the overmind can target an object they can see within 120 feet of them that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn't being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. The overmind can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

  • 5. Lightning Bolt.

    The overmind shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

  • 6. Fire Beam.

    The targeted creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and catches fire, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). Any creature can use their action to douse the fire, ending the effect early.

Ellan speaks a one-word command to up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet of him.

Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on their next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, doesn't understand Common or Elvish, or would be directly harmed by following the command. If the target can't follow Ellan's command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects follow:

  • Approach.

    The target moves toward Ellan by the shortest and most direct route, ending their turn if they move within 5 feet of Ellan.

  • Drop.

    The target drops whatever they are holding and then ends their turn.

  • Flee.

    The target spends their turn moving away from Ellan by the fastest available means.

  • Grovel.

    The target falls prone and then ends their turn.

  • Halt.

    The target doesn't move and takes no actions.

actions.name: Vacuous Breath (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml:
Qazyldrath exhales dark energy in a line that is 90 feet long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) acid damage plus 24 (7d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no light except a daylight spell or a light-creating spell of 5th level or higher can illuminate it.
entries: Qazyldrath exhales dark energy in a line that is 90 feet long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage plus 24 ({@damage 7d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no light except a {@spell daylight} spell or a light-creating spell of 5th level or higher can illuminate it.

bonusActions.name: Enshroud
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Shadows cling to one creature Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded and vulnerable to necrotic damage until the start of Qazyldrath's next turn.
entries: Shadows cling to one creature Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and vulnerable to necrotic damage until the start of Qazyldrath's next turn.

reactions.name: Thwart Healing
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature within 60 feet of Qazyldrath regains hit points, Qazyldrath forces them to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regains half the number of hit points instead.
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Qazyldrath regains hit points, Qazyldrath forces them to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regains half the number of hit points instead.

legendaryActions.description: Qazyldrath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: Burning Globs
entries.descriptionHtml: Qazyldrath spits acid globules at each enemy they can see within 90 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or have a globule attached to their body. A creature attached to a globule takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove a globule from themself or a creature they can reach.
entries: Qazyldrath spits acid globules at each enemy they can see within 90 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or have a globule attached to their body. A creature attached to a globule takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove a globule from themself or a creature they can reach.

entries.name: Action 2: Shadow Form
entries.descriptionHtml: Qazyldrath becomes semiincorporeal, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of their next turn. Qazyldrath then teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that they can see.
entries: Qazyldrath becomes semiincorporeal, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of their next turn. Qazyldrath then teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that they can see.

entries.name: Action 3: Sinking Gloom
entries.descriptionHtml: Qazyldrath summons sticky black acid centered on a point they can see on the ground within 120 feet of them, creating a 5-foot-deep, 20-foot-radius pool. The pool is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 minute. An enemy who starts their turn in the pool takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the start of their next turn. An enemy who starts their turn flying within 30 feet of the pool must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled down by living acid, landing in the nearest unoccupied space of their choice within the pool, take 24 (7d6) acid damage, and be restrained until the start of their next turn.
entries: Qazyldrath summons sticky black acid centered on a point they can see on the ground within 120 feet of them, creating a 5-foot-deep, 20-foot-radius pool. The pool is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 minute. An enemy who starts their turn in the pool takes 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn. An enemy who starts their turn flying within 30 feet of the pool must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled down by living acid, landing in the nearest unoccupied space of their choice within the pool, take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage, and be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn.

lairActions.name: Acidic Gas
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Corrosive gas erupts in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) acid damage.
entries: Corrosive gas erupts in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage.

lairActions.name: Consume Light
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Qazyldrath extinguishes one or more light sources they can see within 120 feet of them. Qazyldrath regains 5 (1d10) hit points for each light source they extinguished.
entries: Qazyldrath extinguishes one or more light sources they can see within 120 feet of them. Qazyldrath regains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points for each light source they extinguished.

lairActions.name: Hungry Gloom
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Grasping shadows sap the vitality of each enemy in dim light or darkness within 120 feet of Qazyldrath. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and be restrained until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.
entries: Grasping shadows sap the vitality of each enemy in dim light or darkness within 120 feet of Qazyldrath. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage and be {@condition restrained} until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round.

lairHeader: When fighting inside his lair, Qazyldrath can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Qazyldrath can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; Qazyldrath can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:
lairActionsDesc: When fighting inside his lair, Qazyldrath can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Qazyldrath can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; Qazyldrath can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:

traits.name: Crafty
traits.descriptionHtml: Queen Bargnot doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she moves out of an enemy's reach.
entries: Queen Bargnot doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she moves out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Take My Pain (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: When Queen Bargnot fails a saving throw against a spell or other supernatural effect, she can choose a willing creature within 30 feet of her. Queen Bargnot succeeds on the saving throw, the creature is targeted with the same spell or effect as if they were in her space, and they fail their saving throw automatically.
entries: When Queen Bargnot fails a saving throw against a spell or other supernatural effect, she can choose a willing creature within 30 feet of her. Queen Bargnot succeeds on the saving throw, the creature is targeted with the same spell or effect as if they were in her space, and they fail their saving throw automatically.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Queen Bargnot makes three Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks.
entries: Queen Bargnot makes three Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Get In Here
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Queen Bargnot shouts for aid and 1d4 goblin lackeys appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of her.
entries: Queen Bargnot shouts for aid and {@dice 1d4} {@creature goblin lackey|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of her.

reactions.name: No Dying!
reactions.descriptionHtml: When an ally Queen Bargnot can see within 30 feet of her is reduced to 0 hit points, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead.
entries: When an ally Queen Bargnot can see within 30 feet of her is reduced to 0 hit points, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead.

legendaryActions.description:
Queen Bargnot has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn.
She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: What Are You Waiting For?!
entries.descriptionHtml: Each ally within 60 feet of Queen Bargnot who can hear her can move up to their speed or make a melee weapon attack (no action required).
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of Queen Bargnot who can hear her can move up to their speed or make a melee weapon attack (no action required).

entries.name: Action 2: Focus Fire
entries.descriptionHtml: Queen Bargnot chooses an enemy she can see with 60 feet of her. Queen Bargnot and each ally within 60 feet of her who can hear her can move up to their speed toward the target.
entries: Queen Bargnot chooses an enemy she can see with 60 feet of her. Queen Bargnot and each ally within 60 feet of her who can hear her can move up to their speed toward the target.

entries.name: Action 3: Kill!
entries.descriptionHtml: Each ally within 60 feet of Queen Bargnot who can hear her can make a weapon attack with advantage (no action required). If the attack hits, it deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage.
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of Queen Bargnot who can hear her can make a weapon attack with advantage (no action required). If the attack hits, it deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: When Radlee makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.
entries: When Radlee makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.descriptionHtml: Radlee has advantage on saving throws against being moved against her will or knocked prone.
entries: Radlee has advantage on saving throws against being moved against her will or knocked {@condition prone}.

traits.name: Tactical Vigilance
traits.descriptionHtml:
Radlee has advantage on initiative checks.

While she isn't incapacitated, Radlee and each ally within 30 feet of her who can see or hear her can't be surprised.
entries: Radlee has advantage on initiative checks.
While she isn't {@condition incapacitated}, Radlee and each ally within 30 feet of her who can see or hear her can't be surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Radlee makes three Halberd or three Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Halberd attack and uses Backswipe.
entries: Radlee makes three Halberd or three Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Halberd attack and uses Backswipe.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) slashing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

actions.name: Backswipe
actions.descriptionHtml: Radlee swings her halberd's shaft at a creature within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.
entries: Radlee swings her halberd's shaft at a creature within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reactions.name: Protector
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature Radlee can see within 10 feet of her attacks one of her allies, Radlee can make a Halberd attack against the attacker.
entries: When a creature Radlee can see within 10 feet of her attacks one of her allies, Radlee can make a Halberd attack against the attacker.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Rot Angel
languages: understands Celestial but can't speak it

traits.name: Flyby
traits.descriptionHtml: The angel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.
entries: The angel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Decaying Touch
actions.descriptionHtml:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, or if the target is a corpse or Undead, the damage increases to 36 (8d8).

Additionally, for the next 24 hours, the target is marked for death. A creature who drops to 0 hit points while marked for death immediately fails one death saving throw. This effect isn't cumulative.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, or if the target is a corpse or Undead, the damage increases to 36 ({@dice 8d8}).

Additionally, for the next 24 hours, the target is marked for death. A creature who drops to 0 hit points while marked for death immediately fails one death saving throw. This effect isn't cumulative.

bonusActions.name: Hypnotic Beam
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: One of the angel's eyes shoots a magic ray at a creature the angel can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move as far as their speed allows toward the angel, avoiding obviously dangerous ground.
entries: One of the angel's eyes shoots a magic ray at a creature the angel can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move as far as their speed allows toward the angel, avoiding obviously dangerous ground.

reactions.name: Radiant Puff
reactions.descriptionHtml: When the angel is hit with an attack, they release a cloud of spores. Each creature within 10 feet of the angel must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the rot angel's next turn.
entries: When the angel is hit with an attack, they release a cloud of spores. Each creature within 10 feet of the angel must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the rot angel's next turn.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Forest Rot
traits.descriptionHtml:
When the rotbeast dies, they release a burst of infectious air. Each non-Fungus creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of exhaustion and become infected with forest rot disease. An infected creature regains half the normal number of hit points when they spend Hit Dice or finish a long rest, and they can't reduce their exhaustion level by finishing a long rest.

Each time a creature with forest rot finishes a long rest, they must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains another level of exhaustion. On a successful save, the creature loses a level of exhaustion.

If a successful saving throw reduces the infected creature's level of exhaustion below 1, the creature recovers from the disease.
entries: When the rotbeast dies, they release a burst of infectious air. Each non-Fungus creature within 5 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion} and become infected with forest rot disease. An infected creature regains half the normal number of hit points when they spend Hit Dice or finish a long rest, and they can't reduce their {@condition exhaustion} level by finishing a long rest.

Each time a creature with forest rot finishes a long rest, they must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains another level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful save, the creature loses a level of {@condition exhaustion}.
If a successful saving throw reduces the infected creature's level of {@condition exhaustion} below 1, the creature recovers from the disease.

traits.name: Rotwake
traits.descriptionHtml: When the rotbeast leaves a space, it becomes difficult terrain for creatures other than rotbeasts for 24 hours. When a non-Fungus creature enters that space for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: When the rotbeast leaves a space, it becomes difficult terrain for creatures other than rotbeasts for 24 hours. When a non-Fungus creature enters that space for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The rotbeast makes two attacks using Weakening Horns, Rotting Hooves, or both.
entries: The rotbeast makes two attacks using Weakening Horns, Rotting Hooves, or both.

actions.name: Weakening Horns
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of their next turn.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Rotting Hooves
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or contract forest rot.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract forest rot.

bonusActions.name: Healing Rot (1/Day)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The rotbeast regains 3 (1d6) hit points for each creature within 60 feet of them infected with forest rot.
entries: The rotbeast regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points for each creature within 60 feet of them infected with forest rot.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Rotted Path
traits.descriptionHtml: The rotbeast and their caregiver ignore mundane difficult terrain.
entries: The rotbeast and their caregiver ignore mundane difficult terrain.

actions.name: Signature Attack (Horns)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 plus PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 plus PB piercing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

actions.name: 1st Level: Tainting Attack (2 Ferocity)
actions.descriptionHtml: The rotbeast makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 0d1 + PB piercing damage, and the area within 5 feet of the target becomes difficult terrain for the rotbeast's enemies until the start of the rotbeast's next turn.
entries: The rotbeast makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} piercing damage, and the area within 5 feet of the target becomes difficult terrain for the rotbeast's enemies until the start of the rotbeast's next turn.

actions.name: 3rd Level: Rotting Hooves (5 Ferocity)
actions.descriptionHtml: The rotbeast moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 0d1 + PB bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the rotbeast's next turn.
entries: The rotbeast moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the rotbeast's next turn.

actions.name: 5th Level: Rotwake Charge (8 Ferocity)
actions.descriptionHtml: The rotbeast moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, tainting the ground beneath their hooves and making it mundane difficult terrain for their enemies until the start of the rotbeast's next turn. During this move, the rotbeast can move through the space of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. When a creature enters tainted ground for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a DC 10 plus PB Constitution saving throw, taking PBd8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: The rotbeast moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks, tainting the ground beneath their hooves and making it mundane difficult terrain for their enemies until the start of the rotbeast's next turn. During this move, the rotbeast can move through the space of Large or smaller creatures as if they were difficult terrain. When a creature enters tainted ground for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage PBd8} poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Rotting Zombie
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Minion
traits.descriptionHtml: If the zombie takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the zombie takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.
entries: If the zombie takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the zombie takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Overwhelm
traits.descriptionHtml: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more rotting zombies who can see them, the enemy's speed is reduced by 5 feet for each rotting zombie within 5 feet of them until the start of their next turn. If this reduces the enemy's walking speed to 0, they are restrained for the duration.
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more rotting zombies who can see them, the enemy's speed is reduced by 5 feet for each rotting zombie within 5 feet of them until the start of their next turn. If this reduces the enemy's walking speed to 0, they are {@condition restrained} for the duration.

traits.name: Rise Again
traits.descriptionHtml: The first time a zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage other than radiant damage but their body isn't destroyed, they regain hit points equal to their hit point maximum, and they fall prone and are incapacitated until the start of their next turn.
entries: The first time a zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage other than radiant damage but their body isn't destroyed, they regain hit points equal to their hit point maximum, and they fall {@condition prone} and are {@condition incapacitated} until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Slam (Group Attack)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Lethe
traits.descriptionHtml: When the ruinant's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the ruinant must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The ruinant can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.
entries: When the ruinant's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the ruinant must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The ruinant can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

traits.name: Soul Devourer
traits.descriptionHtml: When the ruinant reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the ruinant consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the ruinant's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a wish spell.
entries: When the ruinant reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the ruinant consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the ruinant's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The ruinant makes three Bloodletting Claws attacks.
entries: The ruinant makes three Bloodletting Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bloodletting Claws
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

actions.name: Salt Wounds (Costs 1 Soul)
actions.descriptionHtml: The ruinant chooses up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them who don't have all their hit points. Each target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: The ruinant chooses up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them who don't have all their hit points. Each target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Corrupt Healing (Costs 1 Soul)
reactions.descriptionHtml: When a creature within 60 feet of the ruinant regains hit points from a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ruinant corrupts the effect. The target regains no hit points, and the target and each of the ruinant's enemies within 5 feet of the ruinant must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take necrotic damage equal to half the number of hit points the effect would have restored.
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the ruinant regains hit points from a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ruinant corrupts the effect. The target regains no hit points, and the target and each of the ruinant's enemies within 5 feet of the ruinant must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take necrotic damage equal to half the number of hit points the effect would have restored.

traits.name: Flyby

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

actions.name: Psionic Bolt (1st-Order Power)
actions.descriptionHtml: Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pushed 5 feet away from Sair.

actions.name: Mind Scream (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
actions.descriptionHtml: Sair psionically pierces the mind of each enemy within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is automatically stabilized.
entries: Sair psionically pierces the mind of each enemy within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is automatically stabilized.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.descriptionHtml:
During his first turn, Scarlet has advantage on attack rolls against any creature who hasn't taken a turn.

The first hit Scarlet scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
entries: During his first turn, Scarlet has advantage on attack rolls against any creature who hasn't taken a turn.
The first hit Scarlet scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)

A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

During this move, the vampire ignores difficult terrain, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and can move through creatures and objects. Each creature the vampire passes through must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At the end of this movement, the vampire transforms back into their previous form.

actions.name: Eye Psionics
actions.descriptionHtml:
Xorannox creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who he can see within 120 feet of him. He can't use the same effect twice on a turn.

  • 1. Charm Beam.

    The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour, or until he harms the creature or one of their allies.

  • 2. Compulsion Beam.

    The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make one weapon attack against them. Creatures who can't be charmed are unaffected.

  • 3. Memory Beam.

    The targeted creature must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, if the creature has unexpended spell slots, they expend a spell slot of their highest remaining level, with no effect. If they don't have unexpended spell slots, they instead lose proficiency with a weapon they're holding or carrying for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

  • 4. Toxic Vapors.

    Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

  • 5. Telekinetic Field.

    Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each enemy within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of the move. Additionally, Xorannox can target any object within 10 feet of the point that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn't being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. Xorannox can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

  • 6. Lightning Bolt.

    Xorannox shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

  • 7. Explosion.

    Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

  • 8. Necrosis Beam.

    The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or immediately take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and lose 7 (2d6) hit points at the start of each of their turns. If this effect reduces a target's hit points to 0, they die. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or can't see the target. This psionic effect can't be used again while this effect persists.

lairActions.name: All-Seeing
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Yserthrax projects her senses through her lair, opening emerald eyes on every surface. Until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round, Yserthrax can see every creature in the lair.
entries: Yserthrax projects her senses through her lair, opening emerald eyes on every surface. Until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round, Yserthrax can see every creature in the lair.

lairActions.name: Eldritch Suppuration
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Yserthrax releases a flood of eldritch energy from a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, and until they finish a long rest, their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and their hit point maximum is not reduced.
entries: Yserthrax releases a flood of eldritch energy from a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and until they finish a long rest, their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and their hit point maximum is not reduced.

lairActions.name: Elder Whispers
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Yserthrax whispers a warping word of power to up to three creatures she can see within 120 feet of her who are corrupted by her Corruption trait. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction chosen by Yserthrax.
entries: Yserthrax whispers a warping word of power to up to three creatures she can see within 120 feet of her who are corrupted by her Corruption trait. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction chosen by Yserthrax.

lairHeader: When fighting inside his lair, Yserthrax can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), she can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; she can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:
lairActionsDesc: When fighting inside his lair, Yserthrax can take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), she can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects; she can't use the same lair action two rounds in a row:

traits.name: Death Wail
traits.descriptionHtml: When the yumgrub dies, they let out a distressing screech. Each creature within 15 feet who can hear the yumgrub takes 1 psychic damage. Yumgrubs and creatures who have eaten a yumgrub within the last minute are immune to this damage.
entries: When the yumgrub dies, they let out a distressing screech. Each creature within 15 feet who can hear the yumgrub takes 1 psychic damage. Yumgrubs and creatures who have eaten a yumgrub within the last minute are immune to this damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.descriptionHtml: If the yumgrub takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the yumgrub takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.
entries: If the yumgrub takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the yumgrub takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.descriptionHtml: The yumgrub can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
entries: The yumgrub can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Yum
traits.descriptionHtml: A Small or larger creature can use an action to consume a living yumgrub within 5 feet of them. The yumgrub dies, and for 1 minute, the consuming creature's speed is doubled and they gain a +4 bonus to their Strength score and a +2 bonus to AC. When the effect ends, the creature gains two levels of exhaustion.
entries: A Small or larger creature can use an action to consume a living yumgrub within 5 feet of them. The yumgrub dies, and for 1 minute, the consuming creature's speed is doubled and they gain a +4 bonus to their Strength score and a +2 bonus to AC. When the effect ends, the creature gains two levels of {@condition exhaustion}.

actions.name: Bite (Group Attack)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +-1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit -1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Battle Tranquility (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: When Aastrika fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does so, she can't use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.
entries: When Aastrika fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does so, she can't use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.

traits.name: Molten Flesh
traits.descriptionHtml: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches Aastrika or hits her with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches Aastrika or hits her with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Aastrika takes the Disengage action and makes up to three attacks using Unarmed Strike, Hurl Flame, or both.
entries: Aastrika takes the Disengage action and makes up to three attacks using Unarmed Strike, Hurl Flame, or both.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, they are outlined in red light until the start of Aastrika's next turn, and for the duration, attack rolls against them have advantage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the target is a creature, they are outlined in red light until the start of Aastrika's next turn, and for the duration, attack rolls against them have advantage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 180 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage.
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) fire damage.

actions.name: Lava Pillar (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: Aastrika causes a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder of lava to erupt from the ground at a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (11d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: Aastrika causes a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder of lava to erupt from the ground at a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 ({@damage 11d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Sweltering Heat
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Aastrika's inner flame pulses harshly. Each creature within 20 feet of her who doesn't have resistance or immunity to fire damage must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of exhaustion.
entries: Aastrika's inner flame pulses harshly. Each creature within 20 feet of her who doesn't have resistance or immunity to fire damage must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

reactions.name: Power of Flame
reactions.descriptionHtml: When another fire giant Aastrika can see within 60 feet of her misses with a weapon attack, Aastrika causes flame to trail from the attacker. The attacker rolls damage for the attack as if they had hit, and the target takes half that amount as fire damage instead of taking the full amount of normal damage.
entries: When another fire giant Aastrika can see within 60 feet of her misses with a weapon attack, Aastrika causes flame to trail from the attacker. The attacker rolls damage for the attack as if they had hit, and the target takes half that amount as fire damage instead of taking the full amount of normal damage.

legendaryActions.description: Aastrika has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

entries.name: Action 1: Forward!
entries.descriptionHtml: Aastrika and up to three creatures she can see can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee attack each.
entries: Aastrika and up to three creatures she can see can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee attack each.

entries.name: Action 2: The Manifold Self
entries.descriptionHtml: Aastrika disappears in a flash of light and teleports, reappearing in an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her. At the same time, five fire giant troopers appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the space she teleported from. The troopers act immediately after this villain action is taken and on the same initiative count in subsequent rounds.
entries: Aastrika disappears in a flash of light and teleports, reappearing in an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her. At the same time, five {@creature fire giant trooper|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the space she teleported from. The troopers act immediately after this villain action is taken and on the same initiative count in subsequent rounds.

entries.name: Action 3: This. Ends. Now
entries.descriptionHtml: Aastrika and each willing fire giant within 60 feet of her unleashes a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of Aastrika or one of these fire giants must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: Aastrika and each willing fire giant within 60 feet of her unleashes a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of Aastrika or one of these fire giants must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Zombie
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Negative Nerves
traits.descriptionHtml: Whenever a creature deals 5 damage or less to the zombie, the zombie takes no damage instead.
entries: Whenever a creature deals 5 damage or less to the zombie, the zombie takes no damage instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Delayed Reflex
reactions.descriptionHtml: When the zombie's Negative Nerves trait allows them to ignore damage dealt by a creature the zombie can see within 5 feet of them, the zombie makes a Slam attack with disadvantage against the creature.
entries: When the zombie's Negative Nerves trait allows them to ignore damage dealt by a creature the zombie can see within 5 feet of them, the zombie makes a Slam attack with disadvantage against the creature.
